name: listing.priceType
title: Field: listing.priceType
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer-visible listing.priceType field.
meaning: Controls how the listing price should be interpreted in buyer context.

invariants.label: Closed
invariants.value: closed means the price is presented as a concrete expectation.

invariants.label: Open
invariants.value: open means the price is flexible or open to negotiation.

text:
# listing.priceType

TL;DR:
- listing.priceType tells you whether the listed price is fixed-like or open to negotiation.

What it means:
- It changes how the numeric price should be interpreted.
- It is not the currency and not a hidden fee mode.

Agent hint:
- When explaining results, combine price and priceType instead of reading price alone.
